name: button-group
useFor: Use to join related actions into one control (a split action, a pager, a copy key beside a field). Put Buttons, Inputs, Selects or ButtonGroupText inside; nest ButtonGroups for separated clusters; use orientation vertical for a stack.
constraints: Mixing blue and white keys without a separator
More than one primary key in a group
source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the keys and the header's trays)
title: Button Group
description: Keys joined into one bar with shared edges, with mist mono text segments and fields.
